title: Ukrainian Pork Dumplings with Yellow Sauce
description: A hearty Ukrainian dish made with pork dumplings in a tangy yellow sauce. Rich in flavor and texture, this recipe is perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground pork, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
To make the dumpling dough, combine flour, water, and eggs in a separate mixing bowl. Knead the dough until smooth.
Divide the dough into small pieces and roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of each dough circle and fold the dough over to form a dumpling.
In a large pot of boiling water, cook the dumplings for 10-15 minutes or until they float to the surface.
In a separate saucepan, combine yellow mustard seeds, white vinegar, and sour cream. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat to a simmer.
Serve the cooked dumplings in the tangy yellow sauce.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
